system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
Delivery is a sacrament now.

At Shadow Courier Initiation 11, your Route's signature Package type gains an additional benefit each time you successfully deliver it (in addition to the L1 doctrine delivery effect):

  • Route of the Wayfarer Tongue (Message). Delivering grants the recipient Domain +10 Intrigue marks in addition to the L1 effect.

  • Route of the Black Stair (Blade or Key). Delivering banks +1 Surge for you in addition to the L1 effect.

  • Route of the Last Mile (Soul). Delivering reduces Darkness in the recipient's hex by an additional 1 point in addition to the L1 effect.

If you ever change Routes (which the campaign should not normally permit), this feature retunes itself to the new doctrine on your next Soma Break.

args.body: Package Mastery. Wayfarer Tongue (Message): the recipient Domain gains an additional +10 Intrigue marks. Black Stair (Blade/Key): you bank +1 Surge. Last Mile (Soul): Darkness in the recipient's hex drops by an additional 1.
